text:
The amount of carbon dioxide given out by an aircraft depends on the amount of fuel used.
A kilogram of aircraft fuel makes 3200 grams of carbon dioxide.

parts.label: a
parts.text:
The aircraft makes a journey of 800 km and uses 5.3 kg of fuel per km.
Work out the amount of carbon dioxide, in grams, that this aircraft gives out for each kilometre of
the journey.
................................................. [2]
